description: Pre-registration for the skill-description-compression screen: qwen3.8 (the smol serving route per features.tsv smol>tiny; 463/463 captured bodies carry qwen3.8:27b-mlx) against omp's no-model fallback (previewSkillDescription, reproduced with no model call). The bar is a pre-registered 0.8 pass rate on answerable items plus a strictly lower violation rate than builtin on the same check. The shape thresholds (single line, 12 words, 160 chars, 0.4 distinctive-token retention, 0.6 length ratio) are check_skill_compression's content, not separate assertions: under the executor both would reduce to all-answerable-outputs-pass and duplicate each other while contradicting the 0.8 bar, so they were removed. A screen advances or holds the candidate, never adopts it. Evaluated by prove.evaluate_generation_assertions over outputs_fn-produced outputs (replay backend fills model arms); beats-builtin is strict-lower, ties fail. A qwen3.6 ceiling probe was rejected: features.grade binds proof to the route model's digest, so a qwen3.6 receipt would grade UNPROVEN against the qwen3.8 route. Corpus skilldesc-aux-20261003 carries replay profiles (built via assemble; the 1002 corpus did not, which failed route arms closed with no-profile). The runner holds the heavy slot via @_held on run_candidate.
